description.value: The Canadian Music Centre in BC is the British Columbia branch of Canada's national organization dedicated to promoting and preserving the works of Canadian composers, offering a library and resource centre for scores, recordings, and music research. Situated on Davie Street in downtown Vancouver, it serves musicians, educators, and music enthusiasts in a central, accessible neighbourhood. A touring cyclist passing through Vancouver with an interest in Canadian contemporary music culture may find it a worthwhile cultural stop.
